title: Pilot Surge Cookbook for Prospect Staging (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working cook/ops notebook for rapid pilot surges against high-value prospects that need a short, high-touch technical/onboarding run. The goal is to give sellers and SEs a single-page set of heuristics + one-call scripts to reduce friction, shorten time-to-first-success, and create a repeatable staging cadence for pilots that might escalate into Dedicated or Private deals.

Audience:
- Sales Engineers (SE) running technical callouts
- Account Executives (AE) prepping pilots
- Pilot Ops / Solutions Eng who will provision sandbox capacity
- Customer Engineering (post-sign) for handoff

High Level Flow (30–72 hour surge):
1) Intake (AE + SE) — 30–60m: confirm scope, primary success metric, data connectivity constraints, security bar (SAML/VPN/airgap?). Capture in Jira ticket.
2) Sandbox Provision — 2–8 hours: spin ephemeral hosted sandbox (hosted API) + seed dataset (if allowed). If prospect requires VPC, start Private onboarding checklist (longer path).
3) Tech Deep-Demo — 45–90m: hands-on with sample inputs, set expectations on latency/econ. Use the '3-min constraint demo' script (see below). Record session.
4) Rapid Tuning Loop — 1–2 days: 2–3 short runs with different model/config combos (e.g., base open model, Redwood-verified quantized variant, cached variant) to show cost/latency tradeoffs.
5) Success Validation — 24–72h: collect top-3 KPIs from prospect, validate sample outputs, signpost path to Dedicated/Private.

Quick Win Heuristics (what to try first):
- If prospect needs <40ms p50 for short prompts, demo low-latency routing + short-seq model.
- If cost is a blocker, demo short caching & quantized variant with actual token counts from their sample set.
- If strict data isolation is required, prototype VPC stub and show audit/logging sample.
- Always include fallback plan: show how to route to cheaper model under load or fail to cached reply.

AE/SE Call Script (compact):
(Opening) "Hi — our plan for today is to get you a working example with your real-ish data in under 72 hours. We'll run 3 quick variants to show latency, cost, and quality tradeoffs and give a recommendation for next steps"
(Commitments) "We will: provision a sandbox, demo live calls, and give a simple rollout plan. You will: share 1-3 sample payloads and agree the top-3 success metrics."
(If blockers) "If network or legal blocks appear, we'll escalate to Pilot Ops and push an encrypted demo token or recorded session while we sort access."

SE Technical Rapid Checklist (pre-call):
- Confirm sample payloads (n=1–5) + expected output format.
- Check token budget estimate for 3 runs (approx tokens * calls * 3 variants).
- Create ticket JIRA-<account>-pilot and attach examples.
- Provision ephemeral API key / region; note model variant IDs.
- Enable debug logging (token-level cost + latency).
- Prepare 1 fallback script: route->quantized->cache.

Demo Variation Matrix (minimum):
- Variant A: Redwood-verified base model (accuracy baseline)
- Variant B: Quantized/cheap variant (cost baseline)
- Variant C: Cached/prefix-optimized (latency baseline)
Notes: capture p50/p95, cost-per-1000-tokens, and 1 qualitative failure case for each.

Measurements to capture (post-demo):
- p50 and p95 latency for typical sample
- mean tokens-per-call and total token consumption
- quality score (customer-rated 1–5) on 10 sample prompts
- time-to-first-success (hrs) from intake to validated sample

Template: Pilot Intake Summary (copy to Jira issue)
- Prospect: (company)
- AE: (name)
- SE: (name)
- Use-case: (short)
- Success metrics: (top 3)
- Data access level: (none/pseudonymized/live)
- Security needs: (SAML/VPC/HSM)
- Quick recommendation: (A/B/C)

Escalation Ladder (who to ping)
- Pilot Ops triage: pilot-ops@redwood.ai (internal) / Slack #pilot-ops
- Dedicated onboarding: Lina Ortega (lina@redwood.ai)
- Security questions: security-questions@redwood.ai (SRE oncall)

Common Roadblocks & Scripts (short):
- No sample data allowed: run recorded demo + synthetic pseudonymized dataset; include output diffs.
- Legal requires no cloud keys: offer signed demo contract + local docker runbook (longer cycle).
- Latency anxiety: show p50 with primed cache and cold-case vs warmed-case. Visualize token timelines.

Success Criteria (internal quick-check for conversion):
- Customer rated quality >=4/5 on pilot samples
- Token economics within 2x of agreed budget OR clear path to cost savings via caching/quantization
- Willingness to commit to a short PoC for Dedicated or a security checklist to start Private eval

Measurement & Follow-ups (post-pilot):
- Deliver 1-page pilot report within 48 hours of conclusion: p50/p95, cost estimate, recommended next-step (Dedicated/Private/Hosted), blockers and ask.
- SE to create a short 5–10 slide 'ops evidence' deck for AE to present to buyer (template link below).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Need standard template for SSO/VPN stub that Pilot Ops can deploy automatically. Owner: Diego Morales.
- Add canned data-pseudonymization script to repo (PR exists). See linked PR.
- Clarify billing treatment for demo token usage in EMEA pilot accounts (finance confirmation needed).

Repository & artifacts to copy for each pilot:
- repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-scripts (seed, pseudonymizer, demo harness)
- confluence checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/GTMP/Pilot+Ops+Runbook
- demo recording template: /shared_drives/company/misc/demo-recording-template.mp4

Mini annex — 3-minute constraint demo script (SE):
1) 60s: outline input -> expected output -> constraints (latency, tokens).
2) 60s: run Variant A live and share p50.
3) 60s: switch to Variant B (quantized) show cost difference in single table line.
4) 60s (optional): show routing fallback example (failover to cache).

Notes to self (informal):
- Prefer live demos in us-west region for NA accounts; eu-west for EU.
- Keep one small JSON fixture with personally-identifiable-fields already masked to speed demos.
- If AE asks for quick ROI statement, use sample: "~0.3–1.1 USD per 1k tokens depending on config; caching can reduce 60–80% for repeated substrings."

References / Related docs:
- Pilot Ops Runbook (confluence)
- Dedicated onboarding quickstart (drive)
- Field case study: 'Edge Private win - insurance' (internal slide deck)

Last updated notes:
- Iteration 0.1: trimmed down matrix to 3 variants and added the 3-minute demo pattern (Anjali)
- Iteration 0.2: added pseudonymization PR link and SSO owner assignment (Marcus)

If you take one thing from this page: make the first demo measurable. Capture p50/p95, tokens, and a customer-rated quality score. Everything else is negotiation and can be optimized after a concrete result.
